services.desc: Forty five minutes, full body, high intensity and low impact. Childcare available on selected mornings. FORM Mount Pleasant opened its doors in December 2025, and we could not be more excited to grow with the community that made it all possible. What started in Downtown Charleston has expanded into two studios, giving members the flexibility to feel their best in both locations.Our Mount Pleasant studio features 10 Megaformers, an elevated environment, and a private 1:1 room for personal training.Every class is coached start to finish. You will move slowly, hold longer than feels comfortable, and leave shaking. That shake is progress. A single 45 minute class covers the full body: core,
